method: Read immutable git-show router composition, each handler/extractor/validation, auth middleware, geometry transactions/access predicates, import authority and lease worker, catalog SQL repositories, schema/migrations, and style configs. Compared with named SDK models, methods, query/body encoding, full Axios response and binary tile handling. Existing per-operation semantic reviews are retained.
execution: No tests/builds/native jobs were executed in this final source reconciliation; parent runs combined gates.
limitations: Native evidence covers owned fixtures and recorded consumer snapshot, not new type-only SDK inputs.
Live external IDP issuer/client acceptance, Social assertion consumption, deployed gateway isolation and Manage workflow acceptance remain open.
